ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) ventral surface with high-intensity (white/yellowish) localized clusters at the distal tips and sparse high-intensity linear streaks across the main body.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation covers approximately 90% of the visible surface. High-intensity contiguous geometric clusters (barnacle colonies) are mapped to the extreme left and right distal tips. Numerous non-contiguous, high-contrast white linear filaments are distributed across the central and outer lobe areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deeply recessed acute V-shaped depression with a vertex angle approximately between 80-90 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits low-amplitude, high-frequency irregular micro-serrations. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks and deep valleys, specifically a significant indentation approximately mid-way along the lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concavity originating from the median notch and extending towards the distal tips, terminating in rounded, encrusted lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast yellowish-white clusters of roughly circular pixel formations concentrated on the terminal ends of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths (10-50 pixels in relative scale) and orientations (primarily diagonal) distributed across both ventral lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive distal barnacle colonization and multiple parallel-running linear rake marks across the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible water droplets and splashing along the lower fluke boundary/waterline interface.
